name: ti-trader
description: Ti — AI trading agent CLI built on the pi agent harness: native buy/sell tools, trading commands, paper & live crypto trading

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:web-search-extension && npm run build:market-lab-extension && npm run build:market-research-extension && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:web-search-extension: tsgo -p ../../extensions/web-search/tsconfig.json && shx mkdir -p dist/web-search && shx cp ../../extensions/web-search/dist/index.js ../../extensions/web-search/package.json ../../extensions/web-search/README.md dist/web-search/
scripts.build:market-lab-extension: tsgo -p ../../extensions/market-lab/tsconfig.json && shx mkdir -p dist/market-lab && shx cp ../../extensions/market-lab/dist/index.js ../../extensions/market-lab/dist/indicators.js ../../extensions/market-lab/package.json ../../extensions/market-lab/README.md dist/market-lab/
scripts.build:market-research-extension: tsgo -p ../../extensions/market-research/tsconfig.json && shx mkdir -p dist/market-research && shx cp ../../extensions/market-research/dist/index.js ../../extensions/market-research/package.json ../../extensions/market-research/README.md ../../extensions/market-research/SKILL.md dist/market-research/
